notes.title: Here Goes Something!
notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Deity difficulty level for skirmish.
[*] New Campaign chapter: Insurrection.
[*] Double reward weekend bonus now stacks with social distance bonus and is available on all platforms.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Graphical stability improved with regards to video memory leak
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34438515/63f56ae38bba176d17faa8b4d94e1c5916d8be88.png[/img]

notes.title: Love in the Time of Coronavirus
notes.content:
[h1]Social Distancing![/h1]
[list][*] Playing on the steam platform now gives double rewards until further notice.
[/list]
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list][*] New epic coin Franc Somnolent.
[*] New Raktaba'an quest.
[*] New card quotes.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*] Embargo now embargoes stolen goods.
[*] Regent Marsh no longer attacks when feeding Merchant Guild.
[*] Various logging and spelling fixes.
[*] Fixed Vaetha/Embargo and Vaetha/Fireship interactions.
[*] Embargo and Bribery discard faster instead of going into play first.
[*] Tome of Memory, various fixes in weird cases.
[*] Fixed Synod/Shrine of Rebirth interactions.
[/list]
[h1]Under the Hood[/h1]
[list][*] We can now build 64 bit versions so we can update the game on mobile again!
[*] More control of what ads get shown to our users (contact us if you get terrible ones!)
[/list]
[h1]In the Works (Formerly known as Coming Soon)[/h1]
[list][*] New Sealed Pack Tournament Mode.
[*] New Cosmetic Items.
[*] Card Prestige icons.
[*] If you want to be part of the discussion of where the game is headed, come join us on [url=https://discord.gg/woo]Discord[/url]!
[/list]

notes.title: Tournament Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34438515/64df812bf6f032042c9ddc9f48184ac3923efc8a.png[/img][h1]Features[/h1][list][*] New Tournament Hero Vaetha Druj.

notes.title: New Scarce Coin and Some Balance
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34438515/47c1bee3c8fb69dcb018a9dc467f3b174f310aa8.png[/img]
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] New scarce coin Tenkai Penny, swaps itself for opponents coin.
[*] New card quotes.
[/list]

[h1]Rebalances[/h1]
[list]
[*] Ephraimite activation percentage increased.
[*] Tazin Bek activation percentage lowered.
[*] Lackeys will now take the hit when duplicating intercept ability.
[*] Herd of Boars now gives +1 resource on death instead of +2.
[*] Embargo will now stay in play until there is a resource to destroy.
[*] Aline now gains coin when ally is played, has chance to draw ally when one is killed.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Prevented getting locked out when your context card has nothing left to act on.
[*] Cards get less pixelated when zoomed out, also use less video memory.
[*] Fixed missing punctuation in hero banter.
[/list]

[h1]Under the Hood[/h1]
[list]
[*] Backend support for new game mode.
[*] New effects for new game mode.
[*] (these might cause some bugs, we’ll be monitoring!)
[/list]

[h1]Coming Soon[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Daily Quests
[*] New Sealed Pack Tournament Mode.
[*] New Cosmetic Items.
[*] Card Prestige icons.
[*] If you want to be part of the discussion of where the game is headed, come join us on Discord!
[/list]

notes.title: Daramek's Next Top Idol
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34438515/c33af54d27db2f6a99562d507172bb776358f4de.png[/img]
[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Daramek Idol, Shepherd's Ashes.
[*]Two new rare coins, Viaticum and Geuzen.
[*]New epic coin, Peddler's Bezant.
[*]New promotional coin, Laskari Twin Eagle. Play on mobile to unlock!
[*]Leaderboards now show tournament wins and tournament perfects.
[*]You can email support@warofomens.com if you want to opt out of having your ELO displayed.
[/list]
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Matchmaking will try for 60 seconds to match you with a different player than your previous match now in tournament and pvp.
[/list]
[h1]Rebalances[/h1]
[list]
[*]Wishing coin activation percentage lowered by one.
[*]Graveline Drachm coin activation percentage increased by one.
[*]Berserkr summoned by Weregild Seax can no longer be defended from attacks.
[*]Cross and Pile activation percentage increased by 2.
[*]Ephraimite now has chance to proc the spawned coin.
[*]Bank restocks should now be a better distribution of the deck you bring. It's still random, but it'll be more likely to show you everything in a game.
[*]Matchmaking will try for better ELO matches for high ELO players.
[*]Wins and losses will not hit ELO as hard.
[*]Difficulty levels below Master were made easier to compensate for fixing some AI bugs that would make it play better.
[*]Countess Aline now intercepts 25% of attacks.
[*]Tazin Bek now generates a random resource on turn and attacks when resources are spent instead of gained.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Dowager Anibaldo now properly works with Lackies.
[*]AI fixes to make it do less stupid things.
[*]Fix to crash and unitialized card info at Tournament Complete screen.
[*]Cards that heal on start of turn can no longer heal killed cards.
[*]Bounty now loses all gold first then attacks (this probably only affects Vexillius III.)
[*]Coin in store fixed to show proper number of possible coins.
[*]Fixed a crash associated with Condottiere and Coordinate.
[*]Fixed an exploit allowing players to prevent ELO loss.
[*]Fixed a crash with the particle engine associated with long gaming sessions.
[/list]
[h1]Coming Soon[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Daily Quests.
[*]New Sealed Pack Tournament Mode.
[*]New Cosmetic Items.
[*]Card Prestige icons.
[/list]
